title: German Cities — Job-First Relocation Scoreboard
subtitle: Scored for an experienced Bangladeshi software engineer (4y+ .NET/Python, distributed systems, AI/RAG, enterprise integration) using either the Opportunity Card or a student-visa route to skilled full-time work.

columns.label: Jobs
columns.description: Depth of full-time demand and visa-sponsoring employers for an experienced (4y+) .NET / Python / AI-RAG / enterprise-integration engineer — enterprise and corporate employers weigh heavily; junior-generalist volume weighs less. Federal data show 59% of 2024 IT vacancies target the 'Experte' level, so experienced hiring is the favourable slice.

columns.label: Conversion
columns.description: Registration friction, responsible authority, route from either current title, and the lawful point at which full-time skilled work can start. Appointment waits, authority decision time and eAT production are kept separate; missing official timing is scored conservatively.

columns.label: Scale
columns.description: Urban scale, reachable employment base and experienced-software earning power. Uses official city/region employment and BA pay evidence; portal/analytics signals corroborate direction only.

columns.label: Competition
columns.description: Applicant saturation for the roles you can realistically land (higher = better odds). An experienced candidate has better odds than a fresh graduate, tempered where English-accessible roles are scarce.

columns.label: Housing
columns.description: New-lease rent level and how findable a flat is for a newcomer with no SCHUFA (higher score = cheaper and easier).

columns.label: Cost
columns.description: Non-rent burn rate — higher score = cheaper, longer runway on part-time income while job-searching.

columns.label: Parttime
columns.description: Depth of lawful any-field part-time work available while on an Opportunity Card or as a student, including retail, logistics, hospitality and delivery.

columns.label: English
columns.description: How far English carries across the skilled job market and practical administration.

columns.label: Safety
columns.description: Physical safety plus far-right and anti-Muslim risk for a visible-minority Muslim couple.

columns.label: Connectivity
columns.description: Air links to Dhaka (all 1-stop at best) plus public transport.

methodology: Overall is the weighted mean of 11 scored criteria, computed live with raw 0–100 scores. The job-first decision prioritises Jobs (22), Conversion & work authorisation (18), and City scale & earning power (12). Conversion scores separate registration/intake, authority decision or employment authorisation, and physical eAT production; a printing time is never treated as the total wait. A timely application before expiry preserves lawful residence under §81(4) AufenthG, but full-time skilled work under §81(5a) begins only once the authority initiates issuance and records that permission in the interim certificate. Federal 2026 constants: Blue Card salary €50,700 standard / €45,934.20 for shortage and IT occupations; Opportunity Card funds €1,091 per month and work up to 20 hours weekly during search.
caveats: A four-month conversion wait is plausible and Munich now officially warns that EU Blue Card processing can take up to seven months. Do not sign an unconditional immediate full-time start date without confirming work authorisation.
Most cities do not publish an end-to-end Opportunity Card-to-Blue Card service level. Low-confidence scores compare process design and disclosed pressure, not guaranteed personal waiting times.
The eAT card's 4–6 week production period begins after a positive decision or appointment and is not the same as the application queue.

Apply with a complete pack immediately after the offer: job offer or contract, Erklärung zum Beschäftigungsverhältnis, passport and current title, recognised degree/anabin or ZAB evidence, Anmeldung/residence evidence, health insurance, and salary/job-description evidence.

Berlin-commuter additions use VBB's normal-service line patterns. The temporary Berlin Stadtbahn closure through 12 December 2026 changes some central-city access and is not scored as permanent service; always check a dated VBB journey before choosing a home or accepting an in-office requirement.
